The `src` tree holds the Conduit Angular single-page application. The browser loads `index.html` and `main.ts`. They bootstrap `AppComponent` under `app/`. The repository root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) holds the full component map. The INIT report is at [platform/init/INIT.md](../platform/init/INIT.md). For application code, start at [app/AGENTS.md](app/AGENTS.md).

## Scope

`src` contains the SPA shell (`index.html`, `main.ts`) and the `app` package. The package implements RealWorld Conduit routes, auth, articles, profiles, and settings against the REST API. Shared UI lives under `app/shared`. Cross-cutting behavior lives under `app/core`.

## Components

| Component | Path | Responsibility | Local guide |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Application shell | `app/` | Root component, router config, HTTP client, auth initializer, debug hook | [app/AGENTS.md](app/AGENTS.md) |
| Auth | `app/core/auth/` | Login and register UI, JWT storage, `UserService`, guards on protected routes | [app/core/AGENTS.md](app/core/AGENTS.md) |
| HTTP interceptors | `app/core/interceptors/` | API base URL, `Token` header, error handling for API responses | [app/core/AGENTS.md](app/core/AGENTS.md) |
| Layout | `app/core/layout/` | `nav.navbar` header and footer around `router-outlet` | [app/core/AGENTS.md](app/core/AGENTS.md) |
| Core models | `app/core/models/` | Shared `Errors` and loading-state types | [app/core/AGENTS.md](app/core/AGENTS.md) |
| Article feature | `app/features/article/` | Home feed, editor, article detail, comments, favorites | [app/features/AGENTS.md](app/features/AGENTS.md) |
| Profile feature | `app/features/profile/` | Profile pages, user articles and favorites child routes | [app/features/AGENTS.md](app/features/AGENTS.md) |
| Settings feature | `app/features/settings/` | Profile update form and logout | [app/features/AGENTS.md](app/features/AGENTS.md) |
| Shared components | `app/shared/components/` | Reusable UI such as `.error-messages` via `app-list-errors` | [app/AGENTS.md](app/AGENTS.md) |
| Shared pipes | `app/shared/pipes/` | `defaultImage` for null avatars per conformance selectors | [app/AGENTS.md](app/AGENTS.md) |

## Read first

| Topic | Path |
| --- | --- |
| Bootstrap | `main.ts`, `app/app.config.ts` |
| Routes and guards | `app/app.routes.ts` |
| Shell template | `app/app.component.html`, `app/app.component.ts` |
| API prefix and startup auth | `app/app.config.ts` (`initAuth`, `window.__conduit_debug__`) |
| System map | [ARCHITECTURE.md](../ARCHITECTURE.md) |

`app.config.ts` registers interceptors in order: `apiInterceptor`, `tokenInterceptor`, `errorInterceptor`. The app initializer validates `jwtToken` in `localStorage` or purges auth when missing.

## Use these skills

**Under `app/` (see [app/AGENTS.md](app/AGENTS.md))**

- **run-vitest-unit-tests** — Run Vitest for units that cover services, pipes, and components in `src/app`.

**Conformance E2E (SPA under this tree; specs in `realworld/`)**

- [add-e2e-health-spec](../realworld/skills/add-e2e-health-spec/SKILL.md) — Smoke routes and navbar after changes to bootstrap or layout.
- [add-e2e-null-fields-spec](../realworld/skills/add-e2e-null-fields-spec/SKILL.md) — Null `image` and `bio` with `defaultImage` and settings forms.
- [add-e2e-spa-invalid-token-spec](../realworld/skills/add-e2e-spa-invalid-token-spec/SKILL.md) — Invalid `jwtToken` and unauthenticated UI.

Broader Playwright, API, and docs workflows are listed in [realworld/AGENTS.md](../realworld/AGENTS.md). Command reference is in [TESTING.md](../TESTING.md).

## Check a change

| Scope | Command | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Any edit under `src/app` | `bun run test` | documented |
| Route, auth, or layout visible in the browser | `bun run test:e2e` (or a single spec per [TESTING.md](../TESTING.md)) | documented |
| Format before push | `bun run format:check` | documented |

Prefer the narrowest Vitest file or spec that touches the code you changed. Hooks are described in [HOOKS.md](../HOOKS.md).
